text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but is this the place for the
Zen
meditation lesson?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Grass Wonder. You're most welcome
to join
us. Though there's just one
thing...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My legs are gonna fall off...
I-I can't take
take it
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
People tend to underestimate the
muscle cramps one can get during
meditation. I've been encouraging
everyone to start with shorter sessions,
but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how interesting. In that case, I'd
like to try
an unlimited session.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I figured you would say that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the darkness, you will confront
yourself.
Learning to clear your mind will
become an aid
for you when you run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(A clear mind, nothingness... A state
where all
nefarious elements have left
the body...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Where is this? How did I get to the
track?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky charges ahead! A "Beast"
indeed! Can
anyone catch up? Anyone
at all?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, is there no one here to challenge
me? I
guess the top is mine, thank you
very much. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...No. Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(A clear mind is still far out of my
reach.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(Especially when every inch of me yearns
to make
it to the top!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder! Grass Wonder is closing
in! Will it
be enough?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen such intense
concentration, Grass
Wonder. Did you
reach a state of nothingness?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...No. It seems I still need more time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, I believe I managed to reaffirm

something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My goal. My one destination.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Perhaps this is the effect of Zen

meditation? All distractions have been
cleared
from my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Grass Wonder's commitment
to
training continues to grow more
intense.
